cohort: 150 newborns admitted to NICU with respiratory distress within 72 hours of birth at Singareni Institute of Medical Sciences.
finding: The study found that neonatal respiratory distress (RD) was more prevalent in male babies and those delivered by caesarean section, with transient tachypnoea being the most common etiology and moderate severity being most frequent.
mod_finding: The incidence of respiratory distress was higher in babies delivered through caesarean section (68%).
gest_age: 56% of babies were born to full-term mothers, with others being preterm.
